{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows where flipper_length_mm is missing, since we need it for the mean
# We'll use only the non-missing values for flipper_length_mm
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Group by species and compute mean flipper length
grouped = df_clean.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)

# Display the result
print(grouped)"}
